claims.claim: Growth and degree-proportional preferential attachment form the Barabási–Albert model.
claims.locator: Barabási & Albert (1999), Science 286(5439), pp. 509–512, model and scaling argument

claims.claim: For linear preferential attachment, the candidate probability is k_i divided by the current total degree.
The ideal unmodified BA mechanism has asymptotic degree exponent 3; empirical networks do not necessarily share it.
claims.locator: Scaling analysis; conclusion applies to the stated generator

claims.claim: NetworkX barabasi_albert_graph uses an m parameter, a seed and a default initial-graph convention.
